name: Nagash
canonNotes: The Great Necromancer, once a first son of Khemri's priest-king placed in the Mortuary Cult, who invented necromancy and seized all of Nehekhara.
His Black Pyramid led to his first downfall; his lore bred the first Vampires; he became the first Liche and turned Nehekhara into the Land of the Dead.
Sigmar struck him down when he rose again; now he prepares to rise once more and rule a world of the Undead under his complete control.
voiceNotes: Absolute, ancient and contemptuous; speaks as the rightful master of all death and all the dead.
Every living ruler is a future servant; vampires and liches are his creations, owed obedience.
ttsInstructions: Vast, hollow and absolute; a voice from the grave of ages.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
